scope: Existing canonical Poaceae only; POWO/WCVP accepted names, synonymy, rank and concept caution; no species card, photograph, genus, range or Pages changes

accepted_infraspecific_taxa.source_context: POWO/WCVP accepts this subspecies, with Texas included in its reported state-level distribution; geographic association alone is not identification
heterotypic_synonyms: Poa interrupta Nutt. (nom. illeg., later homonym)

accepted_infraspecific_taxa.source_context: POWO/WCVP accepts autonymic subspecies, with reported distribution mainly southern Mexico and tropical South America; do not treat all species-level historic aliases as Texas subsp. oxylepis

taxa.key_conflict: The installed card has the correct species-level name and Poa secundiflora synonym, but Kew recognizes TWO accepted subspecies with distinct historical synonym sets. Flattening all historical Eragrostis secundiflora, E. oxylepis, E. compacta or E. yucatana records to an asserted Texas subspecies would lose rank and provenance. Preserve author/rank of source names.
taxa.identity_hold: HOLD_SUBSPECIES_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED; existing species-level photos and county specimen references are not independently subspecies-vouchered; retain source determinations and all prior scientific statuses
taxa.hybrid_review: No hybrid identified, hybrid formula inferred, or hybrid HOLD released.
taxa.action: Retain species-level accepted canonical card; document rank-qualified historical names in taxonomy evidence only; no subspecies card or automatic photo re-identification.

taxa.key_conflict: Some authoritative historical floras use Schedonnardus paniculatus as an accepted name, but POWO/WCVP follows the 2010 molecular phylogenetic transfer to Muhlenbergia paniculata. Do not install a duplicate Schedonnardus species or conflate source-determined records without checking their name and authorship.
taxa.primary_authority: Peterson, P.M., Romaschenko, K. & Johnson, G. (2010). A phylogeny and classification of the Muhlenbergiinae (Poaceae: Chloridoideae: Cynodonteae) based on plastid and nuclear DNA sequences. American Journal of Botany 97: 1532–1554. DOI:10.3732/ajb.0900359.
taxa.identity_hold: HOLD_SOURCE_PHOTO_IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL; accepted nomenclature does not independently verify the installed source-labelled photograph
taxa.hybrid_review: No hybrid concept or existing hybrid HOLD changed.
taxa.action: Retain accepted Muhlenbergia paniculata canonical card; preserve existing Schedonnardus/Lepturus aliases and source photo provenance; taxonomy evidence only.

preserve_scientific_states: All existing scientific PASS/FAIL/HOLD/UNRESOLVED decisions, photo source identities, native metrics and county-range records remain unchanged.
